scenes.caption: Isabella shows Seeker her vast fossil collection and suggests they plan a busy day of sorting them.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: tomorrow you can go to my house to see the rest of my fossils, okay? We can sort them out tomorrow, that's two busy jobs.

scenes.caption: Seeker prepares the magical prehistoric potion made by Isabella as a colorful crowd of Frasgles gathers to join their journey.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: Slime, slime, slime... slime-kabime, slime-kabime, seem-kabine, slime.

scenes.caption: They arrive in the prehistoric world and immediately scare away a giant T-Rex with their loudest shouts.

quote.speaker: Dad
quote.text: And the T-Rex said, 'Oh no! What's that noise? Help!' And the T-Rex lifted his tiny arms over his little ears to block out the crazy sound, and he ran away, stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp.

scenes.caption: A giant, slow-moving sloth invites them to its burrow for a warm cup of tea.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: Welcome to my sloth burrow. You see that hole in the ground over there? That's where I live. Would you like to come in for a cup of tea?

scenes.caption: The group spots a woolly mammoth that panics and gallops away when warned about a nearby smilodon.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: Oh, I see a smilodon! Run away, everyone!

scenes.caption: The fierce smilodon appears but surprises everyone by rolling onto its back for belly rubs.

quote.speaker: Dad
quote.text: And all the Frasgles shouted their loudest 'Ahhh's. And then the smilodon stopped and rolled on its back and showed its belly.

scenes.caption: After they return to the castle, Jane the cat discovers a tiny prehistoric shrew-like creature hiding in her pocket.

quote.speaker: Dad
quote.text: That something in the pocket was wiggling. Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle, wiggle.

scenes.caption: Isabella welcomes the tiny creature and offers her wooden dollhouse as its cozy new home.
Isabella uses a bright light to entertain the sleepy creature with heart-shaped shadow puppets on the bedroom wall.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: Yeah, there's this bright light, it makes shadows. And we're going to do shadow puppets. Do you want to learn how to make a heart?

scenes.caption: Isabella reads a soothing bedtime story to the little creature as it snuggles down to sleep.

quote.speaker: Izzy
quote.text: There are sleeping time stories, too, if you want to listen to one of those.
